name: What bathroom finishes are best for an ADU rental unit?

mainEntity.name: Which materials hold up best in an ADU bathroom if the unit will be rented out or used heavily?
mainEntity.text: Which materials hold up best in an ADU bathroom if the unit will be rented out or used heavily?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a rental or high-use ADU, the best bathroom finishes are the ones that resist moisture, clean easily, and can be repaired without major disruption. Porcelain tile is a strong choice for floors and shower walls because it is durable and widely available. Quartz or solid-surface vanities are easier to maintain than porous natural materials. A simple shower design, quality grout or grout alternative, and a reliable exhaust fan all help the room stay in better condition over time. In rentals, it is usually smarter to choose timeless materials that are easy to match later than expensive custom details that are hard to repair. Homeowners should also think about access for future maintenance, since a compact ADU bathroom can be difficult to service if the finishes are overly specialized. If the unit will be used as a long-term rental, durability and moisture control matter more than trend-driven design. That approach often produces the best return on investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: For a rental ADU, the best bathroom finishes are durable, low-maintenance, and easy to replace. Porcelain tile, quartz or solid-surface counters, a standard fiberglass or tile shower, and quality ventilation usually age better than delicate custom materials. The goal is to balance appearance with repairability and moisture resistance.
